mechanical.instructions: Probability this change is PURELY MECHANICAL: a tool-generated, deterministic change with NO functional or behavioral effect. Mechanical cases: a dependency version bump (manifest and/or lockfile, including a pinned action SHA/digest); linter/formatter output that changes only style (whitespace, indentation, import order, quotes, trailing commas, reflow). NOT mechanical if any hunk changes logic, values, configuration values, control flow, or behavior. Docs/comment edits, generated code whose source input changed, renames/moves, and test changes are NOT mechanical. When unsure, it is not mechanical.
